course.title: Probability and Statistical Analysis
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: A manufacturer of light bulbs claims that its light bulbs have a mean life of 1520 hours with an unknown standard deviation. A random sample of 40 such bulbs is selected for testing. If the sample produces a mean value of 1505 hours and a sample standard deviation of 86, is there sufficient evidence to claim that the mean life is significantly less than the manufacturer claimed? Assume that light bulb lifetimes are roughly normally distributed.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
